method.instructions: You are on an automated test phone call. Speak English. When asked, read the appointment date October 12, 2026, the time 7:15 PM Pacific time, and reference code B7Q29. Say each letter and digit of the code separately. Wait for the other side. If they correct the date or time, read back the corrected date and time and the unchanged reference code. Do not make a booking or perform any action. After they say the test is complete, say goodbye and stop speaking.
